summary: Boston Omaha Corporation filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026, disclosing that its board approved a new $30 million Class A common stock repurchase program on September 10, 2026. The program takes effect November 1, 2026, replacing the 2025 program that would have expired December 31, 2026; under the prior plan, 1,607,323 shares were repurchased for roughly $21 million through September 10, 2026. Repurchases may be made via open market purchases, including Rule 10b5-1 plans, at management's discretion. Watch pacing, buyback price discipline, and any signal about intrinsic value versus the prior authorization.
